pose: A female paleontologist with braided hair is crouched over a group of natural casts (positive relief tracks). These aren't holes in the ground; they are raised, 3D 'stone feet' that have popped out of the orange-red sandstone. The tracks show the full top-down shape of the foot, including the thick webbing and the skin-covered ridges of the toe bones. She is using a fine brush to dust the surface of the raised webbing.
